{
  "problem_id": "tmm_problem_cf712123ca1f601b",
  "original_request": "Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (constant refractive index 1.52, lossless), with air incidence (index 1.0). Use only lossless constant-index SiO2 (n=1.46) and TiO2 (n=2.40), one layer of each in either order. Each layer thickness must be between 40 and 160 nm. At normal incidence with s polarization, minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance sampled from 450 to 700 nm at 5 nm spacing. A mean reflectance below 0.03 is the stated target. Use deterministic TMM only, with no RCWA, FDFD, learned surrogate or hardware. Allow at most two executed research rounds with one route and at most 64 solver evaluations per round, seed 17. After observing the actual result, choose a justified adjustment or stop. Do not claim the target was met without the spectrum and independent numeric check.",
  "normalized_request_english": "Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (refractive index 1.52, lossless) with air incidence (refractive index 1.0). The stack must consist of exactly one layer of SiO2 (n=1.46) and one layer of TiO2 (n=2.40) in either order, with each layer thickness constrained between 40 and 160 nm. The objective is to minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance for s-polarized light at normal incidence over the wavelength range 450 to 700 nm (sampled every 5 nm). A mean reflectance below 0.03 is a stated soft target preference. The method must use deterministic Transfer Matrix Method only, excluding RCWA, FDFD, learned surrogates, or hardware acceleration. The optimization allows at most two research rounds with one route and up to 64 solver evaluations per round using seed 17. Final validation requires observing the full spectrum and performing an independent numeric check before claiming the target is met.",
  "primary_intent": "design",
  "secondary_intents": [
    "optimize"
  ],
  "compatibility": "compatible",
  "compatibility_reason": "The request specifies a planar, laterally uniform, linear, isotropic layered medium under frequency-domain plane-wave illumination, which fits the Harness capabilities. All materials are lossless and constant-index, and the calculation method (TMM) is supported.",
  "wavelengths_nm": [
    [
      450.0,
      700.0
    ]
  ],
  "angles_deg": [
    0.0
  ],
  "polarizations": [
    "s"
  ],
  "target_observables": [
    "reflectance"
  ],
  "preferred_behaviors": [
    "minimize arithmetic mean power reflectance from 450 to 700 nm",
    "achieve mean reflectance below 0.03 as a soft scoring preference"
  ],
  "suppressed_behaviors": [
    "high reflection in the 450 to 700 nm band"
  ],
  "known_stack_materials": [
    "substrate: glass (n=1.52, lossless)",
    "incident medium: air (n=1.0)",
    "layer material option 1: SiO2 (n=1.46, lossless)",
    "layer material option 2: TiO2 (n=2.40, lossless)"
  ],
  "design_variables": [
    "layer order (SiO2/TiO2 or TiO2/SiO2)",
    "thickness of the first layer (40-160 nm)",
    "thickness of the second layer (40-160 nm)"
  ],
  "manufacturing_constraints": [
    "layer thickness must be between 40 and 160 nm",
    "exactly one layer of SiO2 and one layer of TiO2"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "refractive indices are constant over the specified wavelength range",
    "interfaces are perfectly sharp and planar"
  ],
  "ambiguities": [],
  "method_research_questions": [
    "which layer order and thickness combination yields the global minimum mean reflectance within the constraints",
    "whether the soft target of 0.03 mean reflectance is achievable given the discrete material options and thickness bounds"
  ],
  "needs_method_research": false
}
